svg.title: White Square
svg.desc: Interpretive hand-authored study after visual inspection of the1996 Guggenheim retrospective plate. Approximate geometry; interpretive palette. Texture, mounting shadows and perspective omitted. Black border is integral to the work, as described by catalogue raisonné author Yve-Alain Bois in his2017 Brooklyn Rail interview; not an external display frame. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for black, white; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://archive.org/download/ellswo00kell/ellswo00kell.pdf#page=120; catalogue 22; visually inspected2026-10-27. Interpretive study, not facsimile.
